name: Eventide's Shadow
oracle_text: Remove any number of counters from among permanents on the battlefield. You draw cards and lose life equal to the number of counters removed this way.
blocked_sentences: Remove any number of counters from among permanents on the battlefield.
You draw cards and lose life equal to the number of counters removed this way.

needs.what: a resolution-time effect letting the controller remove any number of counters, of any kinds, distributed as they choose among any permanents on the battlefield (zero allowed), binding the total removed under `as` so later effects (draw, lose_life) can read it via {"binding": ...}
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The remove_counters op takes a fixed amount of one named counter kind from each chosen object and binds nothing, so it cannot express a player-chosen total across mixed kinds and permanents nor report how many were removed; remove_counters_from_among exists only as an activated-ability cost key, not as an op usable in spell_effects
